entities.name: LCS indicator
entities.description: An information element sent by the network when received via SGs, indicating that paging was triggered by a terminating LCS request in the CS domain.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that sends the LCS indicator IE when received via SGs interface.

entities.name: Paging triggered by terminating LCS request
entities.description: Condition where paging is initiated due to a terminating LCS request in the CS domain.

relations.description: Network sends the LCS indicator IE when it was received via SGs interface.
LCS indicator IE establishes that paging was triggered by a terminating LCS request in the CS domain.
